questionAnswered: What source material in this semantic unit has no semantic disposition?
principle: Source is PRESUMED ACCOUNTABLE. Every character of every region gets exactly one disposition and the DEFAULT is UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE. Heuristics rank and suppress obvious noise; they never decide eligibility.

dispositions.COVERED_BY_INVENTORY: anchored by a CRITICAL/MATERIAL item span
dispositions.COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT: a lead-in whose enumerated children are all accounted, carrying no quantitative value of its own
dispositions.ACCOUNTED_BY_EXTERNAL_UNIT: a region owned by another semantic unit through an explicit link carrying owner ref AND owner inventory hash
dispositions.STRUCTURAL_NOISE: enumerators, punctuation and closed-class connectives only - the residue of splitting a parent unit
dispositions.HEADING_OR_LABEL: a section caption with no internal sentence terminator
dispositions.CITATION_ONLY: a bare cross-reference with no proposition
dispositions.DEFINED_TERM_LABEL: a quoted term label with no operative body
dispositions.UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE: THE DEFAULT - nothing accounts for this text

whatIsNoLongerAGate: any region label or region kind
residueArithmetic: Coverage is computed per RESIDUE inside each unit, not per unit. Partial coverage yields uncovered character runs that are classified on their own, so no fraction of a sentence can hide behind an adjacent covered span.
valueRule: Every quantitative kind, every region. A value is unaccounted unless a CRITICAL/MATERIAL item anchors it; a value inside deterministically non-semantic source is not reported, and a fragment carrying a value is never dismissed as noise.
modelRole: The gap re-inventory call is REMEDIATION. Detection is deterministic and runs before and after it; whatever the model returns, coverage is recomputed and any residue is surfaced.
